title: sieve: message context implementation for RFC 5322 bytes
description: Implement crates/sieve/src/message.rs. Struct Rfc5322Message<'a> that implements MessageContext. Takes raw RFC 5322 message bytes (&[u8]) + SMTP envelope (from addr string, to addr string). Parses headers on construction: split headers from body at first blank line, split each header line on ':', handle continuation lines (lines starting with whitespace fold into previous header), case-insensitive header name lookup. headers(name) returns all values for that header name. body_size() returns total byte length. No MIME parsing needed — just raw header extraction. Tests: parse a multi-header message, verify folded header continuation, verify case-insensitive lookup, verify body_size matches total bytes.
